belfast_boutique_keeper.text: Well, how's it going? They called this place Linenopolis once. We keep the tradition going, with fewer looms.

then.text: Is that your {worn_coat}? Dead on. It'll see you through a Belfast shower.
Good {worn_hat}. Very Linenhall. I'd wear that to the shipyard, if they still let me.
That {worn_top} is class. Linen next, do you think?
That {worn_neck} sits well on you. A good thing at your throat saves a lot of grumbling.
And those {worn_shoes}: you can tell a lot from a person's feet. Good things.

else.text: Dressed for the rain and not much else. Have a look about.

belfast_boutique_keeper.text: Come back when you want something else. We don't close, we just get sleepier.
